item.title: Durable Goods & UMich Final in Focus — Hormuz Fog Clouds All
item.description: Hormuz Day 56 and the inflation afterburner is firing on all cylinders. ECB holds next Thursday but the IMF's +50bp call for 2026 is the elephant in the room. BTP-Bund at 79bp — periphery stress is the trade. The desk goes into the weekend long spread, long breakevens.

item.title: Flash PMI Day: EZ Slides Into Contraction as US Manufacturing Surges — Stagflation Trade Goes Global
item.description: PMI divergence day. The Eurozone just printed its worst composite reading in 17 months while US manufacturing surged to a near-4-year high. This isn't just a data surprise — it's a structural split that redefines CB policy paths, curve trades, and cross-currency positioning for the quarter. The council retained 15 of 24 trades, with the ECB-Fed 2Y spread and Bund steepener as top conviction.
